from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A provided paper with its citation/reference relationships to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (determined by cross-document analysis)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
